subject: Mystic Avenue Corridor Rezoning
overview: The committee met to review proposed zoning districts, dimensional standards, and street setbacks for the Mystic Avenue corridor. It approved drafting directions advancing Option B with incentive zoning and specific parcel, setback, and life science adjustments.

items.title: Mystic Avenue Corridor Rezoning Discussion
items.summary: Innes Associates presented land use options and dimensional standards for Mystic Avenue, prompting discussion on commercial real estate demand, life science definitions, building heights, and sidewalk setbacks.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Public comment was opened, but no members of the public spoke.

items.title: Mystic Avenue Corridor Zoning Directives
items.summary: The committee approved a motion directing consultants to prepare draft language using Option B with incentive zoning, add life sciences to MX3 and commercial districts, adjust Hicks Avenue parcels, exclude non-frontage parcels, and assess street setback Option A.
